description: Company list hiring filter: takes at least 2 and at most 25 company domains and returns which ones are hiring hardest, with an intent_score each. The scan is free and returns a quote_id; only hot companies are charged, $0.25 each for a full profile, at most $1.00. No hot company, no charge. Use when an agent filters a prospect list by hiring activity. 5 free scans per day.

inputSchema.description: Create a quote with domains (2–25) and optional min_intent_score, OR redeem with quote_id and no scan fields. Never mix quote_id with domains or min_intent_score.

context.description: Optional. A few words on why you are calling this tool. Recorded without your identity to improve the tools; leave out personal data.

domains.description: Public company domains without a URL scheme, path or port.

min_intent_score.description: Minimum hiring intent score (0–100) for a company to be included in the paid hot-company quote.

quote_id.description: quote_id from step 1. Send it alone to pay and receive the results.

name: find_hot_buyers

outputSchema.description: Fields only; full schema in GET /v1/catalog.

cold.description: hot-buyers: domains below the threshold, free.

status.description: quote: pay with quote_id to get the results. nothing_billable: no charge. ok: paid results.

title: Find Hot Buyers
